frozen.providerPolicy: public settings fixture only; same fixture policy across modes

balanced.traceMeasurementNote: observedResolverExtractionBudgetCounter is the maximum of emitted cumulative counter snapshots, not a physical extractor or HTTP request count; zero snapshots do not mean no extraction when logical extraction_start events are present. Shared lookup events are joined only when one native operation owns the lookup; ambiguous consumers are left unassigned.

observedResolverExtractionBudgetCounter is the maximum of emitted cumulative counter snapshots, not a physical extractor or HTTP request count; zero snapshots do not mean no extraction when logical extraction_start events are present. Shared lookup events are joined only when one native operation owns the lookup; ambiguous consumers are left unassigned.

note: Failures remain in attempt denominators; p95 is withheld unless >=20 measured timing samples. Trace fields count allowlisted logical events and observed resolver counter snapshots only; they do not represent HTTP request totals. Concurrent phase duration samples are not additive. Per-attempt RSS is omitted because available child RSS is a lifetime high-water mark.

executionContextAssessment.preflight: Same-binary Vibe cold/warm smoke passed before the full run
executionContextAssessment.caseScheduling: Two cases run serially by the coordinator; each case contains 20 paired cold/warm measured repetitions and 3 warmups per scenario.
executionContextAssessment.resultValidity: All measured attempts succeeded; timing is resolver-diagnostic timing, not playback UI or current/new download-route performance.
